summary: Ctrl-P is rejected before previous-message dispatch. C dispatches cmd.c:doprev_message to the TTY message-history callback. Port the whole topl.c message, prompt, and history family, store its circular history in the message window, and wire active command, line-input, writer, save, and restore callers.

source.branch: A bound previous-message key or prompt reaches the TTY message-history callback; the message window retains the same circular history across writes and save/restore.

evidence: Saved admitted replay challenges/cases/v48/v48-previous-message-history-ctrlp.session.json has one Ctrl-P input; step 0 and C step 1 have identical screens and cursor, and the stored JS stop at step 1 is unsupported hero command at its pre-dispatch repeated-command boundary.

C source src/cmd.c:1806 binds the prevmsg extcmd row to doprev_message; src/cmd.c:3627 rhack dispatches a bound command row without the JavaScript-only ADMITTED_COMMANDS gate; src/cmd.c:164-169 doprev_message discards nh_doprev_message result and returns ECMD_OK.

C source include/winprocs.h:71,153 maps nh_doprev_message to windowprocs.win_doprev_message; win/tty/wintty.c:142 registers tty_doprev_message in tty_procs; win/tty/topl.c:20-119 implements the callback over WIN_MESSAGE data/maxrow/maxcol, with single/full/combination/reversed branches.

C source win/tty/topl.c:172-192 remember_topl stores toplines in the circular WIN_MESSAGE buffer and advances maxrow/maxcol; JavaScript js/tty_message.js currently tracks _ttyToplines and pending text but has no corresponding history ring.

Recorder configuration enables TTY_GRAPHICS by sys/unix/hints/linux-minimal setting WINSRC=$(WINTTYSRC), and include/config.h selects DEFAULT_WINDOW_SYS tty; this rules out nhwindows.c as the recorder callback implementation.
A direct runSegment replay at merged HEAD 02896bd emits the same boundary error before doprev_message dispatch, with one screen, cursor [30,6,1], no unported marker, and 3063 RNG calls.

The complete source family includes topl.c:tty_doprev_message, redotoplin, show_topl, remember_topl, addtopl, more, update_topl, topl_putsym, removetopl, tty_yn_function, msghistory_snapshot, free_msghistory_snapshot, tty_getmsghistory, and tty_putmsghistory. Active callers include cmd.c:rhack/doprev_message; wintty.c:tty_create_nhwindow/tty_putstr/tty_wait_synch; questpgr.c and invent.c message-history writes; and save.c/restore.c history serialization callbacks.

Current saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-5723bb7e10087d27f27a8ec6106f3ac7660597e3-v48.json still stops at step 1: one of two screens and cursors matches, with all 3063 RNG calls matched. The complete source scope includes putsyms; enclosing cmd, getline, and wintty functions receive caller wiring only.
